Class SamplePlayer<K>

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.audio.SamplePlayer<K>
Type Parameters:
K - sample identifier, such as a plugin's own enum
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class SamplePlayer<K> extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Loads and plays independent samples identified by caller-defined keys. Files are converted to signed 16-bit little-endian mono PCM at the chosen sample rate. Samples can overlap, restart or loop; playback calls do not wait for effects to finish.

  • Method Details

    • load

      public void load(K key, Path path) throws IOException, UnsupportedAudioFileException, LineUnavailableException
      Loads or replaces a sample. A failed load keeps any previously loaded sample. Callers decide how to report missing files or unavailable audio devices.
      Parameters:
      key - sample identifier
      path - audio file
      Throws:
      IOException - if the file cannot be read
      UnsupportedAudioFileException - if the file is not a supported audio format
      LineUnavailableException - if the audio device cannot open the sample
      IllegalArgumentException - if conversion to the playback format is unsupported

    • play

      public void play(K key, boolean loop)

      Parameters:
      key - sample identifier
      loop - whether to repeat continuously

    • captureAudio

      public byte[] captureAudio(int frameCount)
      Mixes effects at their current playback positions for recording. Returns signed 16-bit little-endian stereo PCM with identical left/right channels, applying the current volume and saturating overlapping effects. Missing or stopped samples contribute silence. This reads playback positions; it does not advance them.
      Parameters:
      frameCount - number of stereo frames to capture
      Returns:
      an independent PCM buffer

    • close

      public void close()
      Releases all loaded samples. Repeated calls are safe; volume is retained and new samples may be loaded afterwards.
      Specified by:
      close in interface AutoCloseable
